overview.description: The Defiance Global Foundries ETF (AIFR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MarketVector Global Foundries index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of semiconductor foundry solutions companies worldwide. This includes firms that are involved in semiconductor wafer fabrication and related services. AIFR was launched on Sep 9, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
